result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from all six lookups you listed. The full `mvn -o test` run completed with exit code 0. The `*Promotion*` tests also passed. I didn't add a test that checks the description itself.

- **`Promotion.java`**: the record has a new trailing `String description`, null when absent. I kept the old 6-argument constructor, which sets it to null, so existing callers still compile (one is outside `DataStore`).
- **`schema.sql`**: `promotion` has a new nullable column `description VARCHAR(255)`. The 255 limit is my choice, so say if you want a different length.
- **`DataStore.java`**: `createPromotion` inserts and returns the description. The other six methods now select it and fill it in. They are `findPromotionByCode`, `listPromotionsActiveOn`, `listPromotionsActiveOnInRegion`, `listPromotionsByCategory`, `findBestPromotion` and `listUnusedPromotions`.

The database is created fresh from `schema.sql` each time, so I wrote no migration. Older promotions simply have no description.
